# pr
gh pr list
gh pr view 42
gh pr view
gh pr status
gh pr diff 42
gh pr checks 42

# issue
gh issue list
gh issue view 7
gh issue status

# repo
gh repo view
gh repo view owner/repo
gh repo list owner

# nounless
gh status
gh browse
gh browse 42

# global-ish flags on read-only subcommands
gh pr view 42 -R owner/repo
gh pr view 42 --repo owner/repo
gh pr view 42 -w
gh pr list --web
gh issue list --json number,title

# compound commands where every part is individually safe
gh pr list && gh issue list
gh pr view 1 | grep open
